audit_explanation: Neither historical_cyclone_tracks.csv nor wind_observations.csv contains ground-truth binary anomaly labels. The dataset is purely meteorological reanalysis track points.
The reported 90.7% accuracy is merely the proportion of predictions classified as normal (1 - test_outlier_rate). It measures model prediction split, not prediction accuracy against truth.
Literal float 0.95 hardcoded in scripts/train_all_models.py (line 344) because precision cannot be computed without ground-truth labels.
